or any combination of education, training, or experience that provides the required knowledge, skills, and ability to perform the job.
Develop and implement strategic recruitment plans to attract a diverse pool of qualified volunteers.
Design and deliver comprehensive training programs for volunteers, covering relevant policies, procedures, and specific roles.
Foster a positive and engaging volunteer experience, ensuring volunteers have clear expectations of purpose and outcomes.
Maintain clear and consistent communication with volunteers, providing updates, feedback, and recognition.
Match volunteers with appropriate opportunities based on their skills, interests, and the needs of the institution, providing ongoing support and supervision.
Track volunteer hours, contributions, and engagement, providing data for program evaluation and campaign reporting.
Develop and implement policies and procedures related to volunteer management, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.
Serve as a point of contact for volunteers, staff, faculty, and community partners, building and maintaining relationships in various domains, including:
Overseeing volunteer networks that support alum & parent engagement and fundraising.
Partnering with Stewardship team to ensure that volunteers understand the impact of their contributions and are inspired to deepen their engagement with the College.
Building a pipeline of opportunities and volunteers to increase professional networks, career advisory roles, and mentors for Scripps students.
Managing volunteers who assist with admission programs, or engage with admitted students and families.
Managing volunteers who assist with campus events, special programs, or operational support.
Serve as a project manager for volunteer initiatives, holding campus partners and other stakeholders accountable and delegate tasks as appropriate.

Participate in on campus events to represent volunteer programs and increase the visibility of volunteerism with constituents. Provide support for broader Engagement Team events as needed, including Family Weekend, Reunion Weekend, and Commencement.ß
Travel on behalf of the College to represent Scripps at off-campus events, promote volunteer activities, and recruit volunteers.
Active support for the College’s Principles of Community and Institutional Values in the performance of job duties.
Other duties as assigned.
Ability to develop and implement strategic recruitment plans to attract a diverse pool of qualified volunteers.
Skills in recruiting, training, and managing volunteers to support various academic and institutional activities.
Strong communication skills to maintain clear and consistent communication with volunteers, providing updates, feedback, and recognition.
Experience in designing and delivering comprehensive training programs for volunteers, covering relevant policies, procedures, and specific roles.
Skills in building and maintaining relationships with volunteers, staff, faculty, and community partners.
Experience with developing and implementing policies and procedures related to volunteer management, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.
Experience in managing volunteers who assist with campus events, special programs, or operational support.
